sentences.en: The unhappy event made him put an end to himself.
sentences.zh: 那件不幸的事情使他结束了自己。

sentences.en: It is said that the poor are not always unhappy.
sentences.zh: 据说穷人并不总是不快乐的。

sentences.en: Better to be a happy fool than an unhappy sage.
sentences.zh: 做一个快乐的傻瓜总比做一个不快乐的圣人要好。

senses.zh: 不快乐的，不高兴的；不满意的；不幸的，不吉利的
